Solutions :-
Sol.339.(b) middle
The  phrase  'in  the  middle  of'  means involved in some  activity. The given sentence  states  that  I  was involved in a meeting when somebody called me. Hence,  'middle'  is  the  most  appropriate answer.
- Sol.340.(b) Hit the sack- to go to bed or sleep.
Sol.341.(a) bald
'Bald'  means  having  no  hair.  The  given sentence  states that Ravi is bald. Hence 'bald' is the most appropriate answer.
- Sol.342.(d) fell out - to have an argument that ends a relationship.
Sol.343.(b) save
The given sentence states that the teacher asked the students to save electricity  by  switching  off  lights  when they  left  the  room.  Hence  'save'  is  the most appropriate answer.
Sol.344.(b) The
'Bed'  mentioned in the given sentence is specific and we generally use the definite article 'the' before any specific or particular  noun.  Hence,  'the  bed'  is  the most appropriate answer.
Sol.345.(c) whole
